header: Tell us what your till is doing that it should not
subheader: We answer within one working day, and usually the same morning.
lead: The more that goes into the form, the less we have to ask back — and a question asked back costs a day.
bodytext:
Useful to us: your customer number, which branch, and what you saw on the screen. A photograph of the till taken with your phone beats any description, including ours.

If the counter has stopped altogether, do not write. Ring the service number and say the word "Ausfall" — those calls jump the queue.
note: Anything arriving outside office hours is answered from 8am on the next working day.
